title: SHFantasy Master Ladder 5.6 Revise Response
scope: Second hardening pass after 5.6 source review: auth fail-closed, database-level atomic settlement, frozen bounded benchmark percentile, and data-integrity regression tests.
implemented: Changed SHFANTASY_AUTH_MODE default from dev to disabled so X-SHF-User-ID is rejected unless dev mode is explicit.
Added production startup guard requiring SHFANTASY_AUTH_MODE=session when SHFANTASY_RUNTIME_ENV is production.
Removed production frontend fallback to the shared hugo identity; dev header identity is generated only for dev/header-auth runs.
Added daily_blitz_rank_benchmarks to freeze benchmark distributions by sport, slate, season, rules, benchmark version, and roster size.
Added benchmark_percentile, benchmark_version, and field_snapshot_id to daily_blitz_rank_events.
Changed rank settlement to run inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE and update ledger, state, and entry rank fields in one transaction.
Changed rank_state updates from absolute overwrite to atomic rank_points increment plus version increment.
Restricted ranked settlement to entries with a non-null ranked_attempt_key; legacy pending entries reveal as unranked.
Changed same-slate scoring comparison to same roster size only, with deterministic sample fallback when combinations exceed the cap.
Renamed player-facing rank language to frozen same-slate benchmark percentile instead of implying actual live entrant percentile.
Narrowed duplicate-attempt IntegrityError handling so unrelated database failures are not converted into practice hands or replay results.
Added rollback coverage proving failed state settlement does not leave a rank event or revealed entry behind.
review_items_addressed: P1 inaccurate actual field percentile wording
entry ranked_status not updated after settlement

deployment.reason: Source hardening is locally verified but should be reviewed before production deployment.
deployment.recommended_next_gate: 5.6/Claude source review of this local delta, then production auth/session middleware confirmation before deploy.

safety: Play-money only. No betting, payment, KYC, deposits, withdrawals, cash-value prizes, or pay-to-win rank effects.
